review:
A gem-like space Megaways with a short feature list. Expanding wilds land in the base game, and in free spins they stick to their reel for the rest of the round.

That's where the swing comes from: a few early wild reels can turn the remaining spins into a run of big wins, while a bonus without them can pay very little. Like Starburst's style, but with much more variance. 96.48% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
